# Falcata Run

> Falcata Run is a watchOS-first sprint training app for track and field sprinters running the 100m, 200m, 400m, and 800m. It captures motion data at 100 Hz on Apple Watch and delivers sprint-specific metrics — reaction time, drive force, cadence, stride length, arm drive efficiency, and time to max speed — that generic running apps cannot measure. Tagline: "The gold standard for sprint tracking." Website: https://falcatarun.com

> Built by Radim Šimánek (https://github.com/Rad1m, https://www.linkedin.com/in/radim-simanek/). Sister app to Ahimo (https://ahimo.app), a privacy-first iOS health app. Personal blog: https://brainintheloop.com.

## Falcata Analyzer (macOS)

Falcata Analyzer is a native macOS app (macOS 15+) that opens sprint sessions exported from the iPhone and reuses the same engine as the Watch and iPhone (single source of truth — no separate desktop calculation path). It provides synchronized velocity / drive force / power / acceleration / arm-swing / ground-contact charts on one shared playhead, pop-out chart windows, a video editing workspace (link external footage, align to acceleration onset, trim, frame-accurate scrub, edit Start/Finish/Distance markers), a configurable telemetry video overlay, and export to video (H.264 MP4/QuickTime with resolution/FPS/bitrate control), chart images (PNG/JPEG), and CSV. It replaced the earlier Python desktop video/analysis tooling.

## Key facts

- App name: Falcata Run (also referred to as Falcata Sprint Run)
- Platforms: Apple Watch (primary), iPhone (iOS companion), Mac (Falcata Analyzer, macOS 15+ desktop review/video/export app)
- Target distances: 100m, 200m, 400m, 800m, plus free runs
- Audience: sprinters, sprint coaches, track and field teams, masters athletes
- Sample rate: 100 Hz accelerometer, gyroscope, and gravity
- Reaction time accuracy: ±10 milliseconds
- Sprint end detection: 3-phase piecewise linear fit (validated 20m–800m)
- Distance source: Apple sensor-fused track-aware distance samples (not raw GPS polyline)
- Key algorithms: velocity-differentiation propulsive G-force, gyroscope peak/bottom step detection, curve compensation with centripetal removal and wrist-aware asymmetry scaling
- Website: https://falcatarun.com
